title: Chicken Fajitas with Peppers and Onions
summary: Sizzling Mexican-style chicken fajitas with tender spiced chicken, sweet peppers and softened onions wrapped in warm flour tortillas. A colourful, quick dinner for sharing at the table.
steps: Put the chicken strips in a bowl with the lime juice, chilli powder, cumin, paprika, dried oregano, salt, black pepper, chopped garlic and 1 tablespoon of the olive oil. Mix well until the chicken is evenly coated.

Heat a large frying pan over medium-high heat. Add the remaining 1 tablespoon olive oil, then add the sliced onion and peppers. Cook for 6–8 minutes, stirring often, until softened, lightly charred at the edges and still a little juicy. Transfer to a plate.
Add the marinated chicken to the same hot pan in a single layer. Cook for 6–8 minutes, turning occasionally, until browned in places and cooked through with no pink remaining.
Return the peppers and onions to the pan and toss everything together for 1–2 minutes until hot and glossy. Taste and adjust with a little more salt if needed.
Warm the flour tortillas in a dry pan for about 20 seconds per side, or wrap them in foil and heat in a low oven until soft and pliable.
Serve the chicken, peppers and onions in the warm tortillas with sour cream and salsa spooned over the top.
